description: Illustrative API requests, not observed results or a comparative benchmark. External study owners supply real independent task/rubric manifests and raw evidence. Replace paths and identities; use the digest returned by freeze in each trial.

tasks.text: Replace this development example with an independently authored question.

facts.text: Replace with an independently established atomic fact.

raw.notice: Replace this example with original recorded answer/tool evidence. No trial has been executed.

record.reason: Illustrative request only; no observed evidence is supplied.

raw.notice: A judged record instead requires material_unsupported, critical_failures and facts keyed by every frozen fact ID; each score is 0..1 with citations_valid and evidence references.

record.description: Replace with actual extraction, indexing and setup work.

record.attestation: Illustrative requests retain unknown usage. Mark complete only when every attempt, retry, worker and setup/synthesis/grader cost is included, with explicit known-zero phases. Closing is final.

contract_notes: No action executes a model, pays for a benchmark, or uploads evidence.
Freeze is idempotent for identical inputs. Changed tasks, rubrics, thresholds, systems or conditions require a new study directory.
Trial status: completed, failed, blocked, cancelled, incomplete, error, unknown. Planned but absent outcomes remain missing in reports.
Retry attempt numbers begin at one and must be contiguous for complete accounting. All workers/calls within an attempt use distinct execution IDs. Repeated task runs use the frozen repetition range.
Execution phases: answering, preparation, knowledge_synthesis, grading. Trial executions are answering; cost records hold other phases and local embedding work.

Input semantics: includes_cached reports total input already including cache; excludes_cached adds cached input once. Missing usage is null. Estimates cannot establish exact usage or budget compliance.
Zero generation is executions: [] with usage_complete: true. A final complete closure attests unlisted phases had zero work; incomplete usage or missing attempts keeps ratios null.
Judged records require status judged, material_unsupported boolean, critical_failures list, and facts containing every frozen fact ID with score 0..1, citations_valid boolean, evidence list.
Model evaluators additionally freeze model, prompt_revision and calibration_revision. Their recorded verdicts remain observations, not independent verification by the reporter.

Optional comparison freezes distinct baseline/candidate IDs, kind component or product, minimum_paired_tasks >= 2, power_analysis, and loss_margin (default zero). A positive loss_margin requires margin_decision. Repetitions are averaged within tasks for paired intervals.
Development/public examples and incomplete or small studies cannot establish no quality loss. Reporting preserves all raw records for replay and labels statistical limitations.
